summary.zh: latest.json 只保留最近两个套件版本的完整迁移说明，更早的条目降为索引（不兼容条目保留一句摘要），全文仍在 release/migrations.json。
summary.en: latest.json keeps full migration text only for the newest two suite versions; older entries become index entries (breaking ones keep a one-line summary), and the full history stays in release/migrations.json.
